name: e2e-llm-sdk-runner
description: Drives one e2e-llm scenario through the Claude Agent SDK, answering the MCP server's in-chat questions from the scenario. Not a workspace member and no lockfile: the Agent SDK is under Anthropic's own terms and never ships, so it stays out of the source SBOM. Only the opt-in E2E_LLM_VIA=sdk lane installs these exact versions and verifies their registry signatures.
